title: Roswell technologies per Corso were German 1940s inventions
place_text: Roswell, New Mexico; Germany; North Africa

tellings.quote: But uh Farrell researched this and he provides documentation that shows that the Germans had invented every single one of these in the 1940s.

related.note: Both are about the technologies Corso said came from Roswell. This telling claims the Germans had already invented them in the 1940s, which contradicts the reverse-engineered-from-the-crash account.

plain: The technologies that Philip Corso, a former Army officer, said came from the Roswell crash, a craft many say came down in New Mexico in 1947, had all been invented by the Germans in the 1940s. That is what a writer named Jason Jorjani tells Michels. Corso made his claims in his 1997 book The Day After Roswell, and Jorjani says an author named Joseph P. Farrell researched them and gives documents showing that the Germans had invented every single one, which would make the Roswell story partly a cover for wartime German science.
